As jy albei kante deur cos x deel, word dit tan x = 1, en tan herhaal elke 180°. Sodra jy dus een oplossing by 45° het, is die volgende een 180° later by 225°, en dit is B se x-koördinaat. Vir die hoogte, vervang 225° terug in enige van die grafieke (albei moet dieselfde antwoord gee, wat 'n gratis kontrole is), en sin 225° is −0,71 tot twee desimale plekke. Om dit van die skets af te lees, is ook toegelaat en gee dieselfde antwoord: die tweede snypunt is duidelik onder in die negatiewe deel van die prentjie, sowat twee derdes van 'n eenheid onder die as.

tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.en: For which values of x is  f(x) > g(x)?
tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.af: Vir watter waardes van x is  f(x) > g(x)?

tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.en: Cut the picture at the two crossings, then look at each strip and ask which curve is on top.
tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.af: Sny die prentjie by die twee snypunte, kyk dan na elke interval en vra watter kurwe bo is.

tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.en: Cut lines at  x = 45°  and  x = 225°.  Between them the sine graph is the higher one.
tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.af: Snylyne by  x = 45°  en  x = 225°.  Tussen hulle is die sin-grafiek die hoër een.

tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.en: WATCH OUT: the sign is strictly greater than, so the crossing points are left out — at 45° and 225° the graphs are EQUAL, not one above the other.
tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.af: PASOP: die teken is streng groter as, so die snypunte word uitgelaat: by 45° en 225° is die grafieke GELYK, nie een bo die ander nie.

tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.en: Two crossings cut the interval into three strips, and only one of them is the answer. Check one easy point in each strip rather than trying to picture the whole thing. At 0° the cosine is at its maximum and the sine is at zero, so g is on top and that strip fails. At 90° the sine is at its maximum and the cosine is at zero, so f is on top and that strip is in. At 360° the cosine is back at its maximum and the sine is at zero, so g wins again. That gives a single stretch, from 45° to 225°, with the ends excluded because the question asks for strictly greater. One tidy answer, one strip, no or needed.
tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.af: Twee snypunte kap die interval in drie intervalle op, en net een daarvan is die antwoord. Toets een maklike punt in elke interval eerder as om die hele ding te probeer voorstel. By 0° is die cos-grafiek by sy maksimum en die sin-grafiek by nul, so g is bo en daardie interval faal. By 90° is die sin-grafiek by sy maksimum en die cos-grafiek by nul, so f is bo en daardie interval is in. By 360° is die cos-grafiek terug by sy maksimum en die sin-grafiek by nul, so g wen weer. Dit gee een enkele stuk, van 45° tot 225°, met die eindpunte uitgesluit omdat die vraag streng groter as vra. Een netjiese antwoord, een interval, geen of nodig nie.

tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.en: How many solutions does the equation  sin x = cos x  have for  x ∈ [−360° ; 360°]?
tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.af: Hoeveel oplossings het die vergelyking  sin x = cos x  vir  x ∈ [−360° ; 360°]?

tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.en: The sketch only shows one turn. Ask how many crossings there are per 360°, and then how many 360° stretches fit into the new interval.
tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.af: Die skets wys net een draai. Vra hoeveel snypunte daar per 360° is, en dan hoeveel stukke van 360° in die nuwe interval pas.

tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.en: Both graphs repeat every 360°, and the sketch shows 2 crossings in one 360° stretch.
tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.af: Albei grafieke herhaal elke 360°, en die skets wys 2 snypunte in een stuk van 360°.

tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.en: The interval  [−360° ; 360°]  is 720° wide, which is TWO of those stretches.
tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.af: Die interval  [−360° ; 360°]  is 720° wyd, wat TWEE sulke stukke is.

tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.en: WATCH OUT: count in whole periods, not by doubling whatever you can see. This works cleanly here because the crossings sit 180° apart and none of them lands exactly on −360° or 360°. Always check the two ends of a widened interval before you multiply.
tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.af: PASOP: tel in hele periodes, nie deur net te verdubbel wat jy kan sien nie. Dit werk hier netjies omdat die snypunte 180° uitmekaar lê en nie een presies op −360° of 360° val nie. Kontroleer altyd die twee eindpunte van 'n wyer interval voordat jy vermenigvuldig.

tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.en: When a question widens the interval past what the sketch shows, use the repeating nature of the graphs instead of drawing more picture. Both sine and cosine repeat exactly every 360°, so whatever happens in one 360° stretch happens again in the next one. The sketch shows two crossings in the stretch from 0° to 360°. The new interval runs from −360° to 360°, which is 720° wide, or two such stretches, so there are two lots of two crossings — four in all. The one thing to check before multiplying is the ends: if a crossing happened to sit exactly on −360° or 360° it would be shared between stretches and the count would be off by one. Here the crossings are at 45° plus multiples of 180°, so none of them lands on the ends.
tgraph-siblings-intersections-inequaliti.af: As 'n vraag die interval wyer maak as wat die skets wys, gebruik die herhalende aard van die grafieke eerder as om meer prentjie te teken. Die sin- en cos-grafiek herhaal albei presies elke 360°, so wat ook al in een stuk van 360° gebeur, gebeur weer in die volgende een. Die skets wys twee snypunte in die stuk van 0° tot 360°. Die nuwe interval loop van −360° tot 360°, wat 720° wyd is, of twee sulke stukke, so daar is twee keer twee snypunte: altesaam vier. Die een ding om te kontroleer voordat jy vermenigvuldig, is die eindpunte: as 'n snypunt presies op −360° of 360° sou lê, sou dit tussen twee stukke gedeel word en sou die telling een uit wees. Hier lê die snypunte by 45° plus veelvoude van 180°, so nie een van hulle val op die eindpunte nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#1.en:
Consider the function  f(x) = 2 sin x.

Write down the coordinates of the turning points of f for  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°].
tgraph-siblings-sketch#1.af:
Beskou die funksie  f(x) = 2 sin x.

Skryf die koördinate van die draaipunte van f vir  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°] neer.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#2.en: A sine graph turns a quarter of a period after it starts, and again three quarters of the way through. The height of a turning point is the midline plus or minus the amplitude.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#2.af: 'n Sin-grafiek draai 'n kwart periode nadat dit begin, en weer driekwart van die pad deur. Die hoogte van 'n draaipunt is die middelste lyn plus of minus die amplitude.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#3.en: The period is 360°, so the turning points sit a quarter of a period either side of the origin: at x = 90° and x = −90°.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#3.af: Die periode is 360°, dus lê die draaipunte 'n kwart periode aan weerskante van die oorsprong: by x = 90° en x = −90°.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#6.en: Turning points are the easiest features to place because a sine graph always turns in the same rhythm: it starts at the midline, reaches its highest point a quarter of a period later, comes back through the midline at the halfway mark, and reaches its lowest point three quarters of the way through. Here a quarter of 360° is 90°, so the maximum is at x = 90°. The interval also runs backwards from the origin, and the same rhythm applies going left, which puts a minimum at x = −90°. The heights are the amplitude above and below the midline, and with a midline of 0 and an amplitude of 2 that is 2 and −2. Working the x and the y separately like this is much safer than trying to picture the whole graph at once.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#6.af: Draaipunte is die maklikste kenmerke om te plaas, want 'n sin-grafiek draai altyd in dieselfde ritme: dit begin op die middelste lyn, bereik sy hoogste punt 'n kwart periode later, kom halfpad weer deur die middelste lyn, en bereik sy laagste punt driekwart van die pad deur. Hier is 'n kwart van 360° gelyk aan 90°, dus is die maksimum by x = 90°. Die interval loop ook agtertoe vanaf die oorsprong, en dieselfde ritme geld na links, wat 'n minimum by x = −90° plaas. Die hoogtes is die amplitude bo en onder die middelste lyn, en met 'n middelste lyn van 0 en 'n amplitude van 2 is dit 2 en −2. Om die x en die y so apart uit te werk, is baie veiliger as om die hele grafiek in een slag voor te stel.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#7.en: Sketch the graph of f for  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°],  clearly showing the intercepts with the axes and the turning points.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#7.af: Skets die grafiek van f vir  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°],  en toon die afsnitte met die asse en die draaipunte duidelik aan.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#8.en: Plot the five landmarks first — the three x-intercepts and the two turning points — and only then join them with a smooth wave. Never join them with straight lines.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#8.af: Stip eers die vyf herkenbare punte: die drie x-afsnitte en die twee draaipunte. Verbind hulle dan met 'n gladde golf, nooit met reguit lyne nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#9.en: x-intercepts: the graph is on the midline at  x = −180°, 0° and 180°.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#9.af: x-afsnitte: die grafiek is op die middelste lyn by  x = −180°, 0° en 180°.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#11.en: Join them with one smooth wave, drawn to scale, with the endpoints of the interval reached and the axes labelled in degrees.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#11.af: Verbind hulle met een gladde golf, op skaal geteken, wat tot by die eindpunte van die interval loop, en benoem die asse in grade.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#12.en: WATCH OUT: a sketch mark is a mark for the SHAPE, not for artistry. Stop the graph exactly at −180° and 180° — carrying it past the interval you were given loses the mark just as surely as leaving out a turning point does.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#12.af: PASOP: 'n punt vir 'n skets is 'n punt vir die VORM, nie vir kunstigheid nie. Stop die grafiek presies by −180° en 180°: as jy dit verby die gegewe interval teken, verloor jy die punt net so seker as wanneer jy 'n draaipunt uitlaat.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#13.en: A sketch question is a plotting question wearing a friendlier name, so do it in the same order every time. First mark the interval on the x-axis and put the ticks where the landmarks will be. Then plot the landmarks themselves: the places where the graph crosses the x-axis, and the turning points. Only then draw the curve through them, smoothly, with rounded tops rather than pointed ones. Two things earn the marks and both are easy to forget. Label the turning points with their coordinates rather than leaving bare dots, and stop at the ends of the interval you were given. If the amplitude is 2, make sure the top of your wave really is level with 2 on the y-axis — a sketch still has to be roughly to scale.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#13.af: 'n Sketsvraag is 'n stipvraag met 'n vriendeliker naam, so doen dit elke keer in dieselfde volgorde. Merk eers die interval op die x-as en sit die merkies waar die herkenbare punte gaan wees. Stip dan die herkenbare punte self: die plekke waar die grafiek die x-as sny, en die draaipunte. Teken eers dan die kurwe deur hulle, glad, met ronde toppe en nie spits toppe nie. Twee dinge verdien die punte, en albei is maklik om te vergeet. Benoem die draaipunte met hul koördinate in plaas daarvan om kaal kolletjies te los, en stop by die eindpunte van die gegewe interval. As die amplitude 2 is, maak seker dat die top van jou golf regtig gelyk is met 2 op die y-as: 'n skets moet steeds min of meer op skaal wees.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#14.en:
Consider the function  g(x) = cos 2x.

Write down the period of g.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#14.af:
Beskou die funksie  g(x) = cos 2x.

Skryf die periode van g neer.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#15.en: The 2 is multiplying the x, so it belongs to the period. Divide, do not multiply.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#15.af: Die 2 vermenigvuldig die x, dus behoort dit aan die periode. Deel, moenie vermenigvuldig nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#18.en: Working the period out before you sketch is the single best habit on this tile, because the period tells you how many waves have to fit into the window. Here the period is 180°, and the window is 360° wide, so exactly two complete waves have to appear in your sketch. That is a check you can do with your eyes the moment you have drawn it: if you only see one wave, the 2 has been ignored, and if you see four, you have divided the wrong way round. It also spaces the landmarks for you — the turning points come every half period, which is 90°, and the x-intercepts come halfway between them.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#18.af: Om die periode uit te werk voordat jy skets, is die heel beste gewoonte hier, want die periode sê vir jou hoeveel golwe in die venster moet pas. Hier is die periode 180°, en die venster is 360° wyd, dus moet presies twee volledige golwe in jou skets verskyn. Dit is 'n toets wat jy met jou oë kan doen sodra jy dit geteken het: as jy net een golf sien, is die 2 geïgnoreer, en as jy vier sien, het jy verkeerd om gedeel. Dit versprei ook die herkenbare punte vir jou: die draaipunte kom elke halwe periode, dit is 90°, en die x-afsnitte kom halfpad tussen hulle.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#19.en: Sketch the graph of g for  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°],  clearly showing the intercepts with the axes and the turning points.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#19.af: Skets die grafiek van g vir  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°],  en toon die afsnitte met die asse en die draaipunte duidelik aan.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#20.en: Two complete waves have to fit. Start at the y-axis — a plain cosine begins at its maximum — then step across in quarter periods of 45° each: maximum, intercept, minimum, intercept, maximum.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#20.af: Twee volledige golwe moet pas. Begin by die y-as ('n gewone cos-grafiek begin by sy maksimum) en stap dan oor in kwart periodes van 45° elk: maksimum, afsnit, minimum, afsnit, maksimum.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#21.en: The period is 180°, so a quarter period is 45° and the landmarks repeat every 45°.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#21.af: Die periode is 180°, dus is 'n kwart periode 45° en herhaal die herkenbare punte elke 45°.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#22.en: y-intercept (0 ; 1) — a cosine starts at its maximum.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#22.af: y-afsnit (0 ; 1): 'n cos-grafiek begin by sy maksimum.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#25.en: Two complete smooth waves across the interval, amplitude 1, drawn to scale.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#25.af: Twee volledige gladde golwe oor die interval, amplitude 1, op skaal geteken.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#26.en: WATCH OUT: the 2 squashes the graph, it does not stretch it. If your sketch shows one long wave instead of two short ones, you have used 360° × 2 instead of 360° ÷ 2.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#26.af: PASOP: die 2 druk die grafiek saam, dit rek dit nie. As jou skets een lang golf wys in plaas van twee kort golwe, het jy 360° × 2 gebruik in plaas van 360° ÷ 2.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#27.en: The quarter-period walk is what makes a squashed graph easy to draw. Work out the period, quarter it, and then step across the axis marking one landmark at a time in the order a cosine always visits them: maximum, x-intercept, minimum, x-intercept, maximum. Here a quarter of 180° is 45°, so the landmarks land on 0°, 45°, 90°, 135°, 180° going right, and mirror onto the negative side going left. Because a cosine is symmetrical about the y-axis, the left half of your sketch is the mirror image of the right half, which halves the work and gives you a free check. The amplitude is untouched by the 2, so the wave still reaches only as high as 1 and as low as −1.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#27.af: Die kwartperiode-stap maak 'n saamgedrukte grafiek maklik om te teken. Werk die periode uit, deel dit in vier, en stap dan oor die as en merk een herkenbare punt op 'n slag, in die volgorde waarin 'n cos-grafiek hulle altyd besoek: maksimum, x-afsnit, minimum, x-afsnit, maksimum. Hier is 'n kwart van 180° gelyk aan 45°, dus val die herkenbare punte op 0°, 45°, 90°, 135°, 180° na regs, en reflekteer hulle na die negatiewe kant na links. Omdat 'n cos-grafiek simmetries om die y-as is, is die linkerhelfte van jou skets die gereflekteerde beeld van die regterhelfte, wat die werk halveer en jou 'n gratis toets gee. Die 2 raak nie aan die amplitude nie, dus gaan die golf steeds net so hoog as 1 en so laag as −1.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#28.en:
Consider the function  h(x) = tan x − 1.

Write down the equations of the asymptotes of h for  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°].
tgraph-siblings-sketch#28.af:
Beskou die funksie  h(x) = tan x − 1.

Skryf die vergelykings van die asimptote van h vir  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°] neer.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#29.en: A tangent graph breaks where the plain tangent is undefined, and the − 1 does not move those places at all. Write each answer as a vertical line.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#29.af: 'n Tan-grafiek breek waar die gewone tan onbepaald is, en die − 1 skuif daardie plekke glad nie. Skryf elke antwoord as 'n vertikale lyn.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#30.en: A tangent is undefined at 90° and at every 180° from there. The  − 1  only slides the graph down, so it does not move the asymptotes.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#30.af: Die tan-funksie is onbepaald by 90° en by elke 180° daarvandaan. Die  − 1  skuif die grafiek net af, dus skuif dit nie die asimptote nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#32.en: The asymptotes of a tangent graph are decided entirely by what is inside the function. A plain tangent breaks at 90°, and then again every 180° after that, which puts breaks at −90° and 90° inside this interval. The − 1 is outside the tangent, so it moves every point of the graph one unit down — but sliding a picture downwards cannot move a vertical line sideways, so the asymptotes stay exactly where they were. That is the useful distinction: a number added or subtracted OUTSIDE never touches a vertical asymptote, while a number inside the bracket with the x slides it. Write each answer as x equals a value; a bare number does not describe a line.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#32.af: Die asimptote van 'n tan-grafiek word heeltemal bepaal deur wat binne die funksie is. 'n Gewone tan breek by 90°, en dan weer elke 180° daarna, wat breekpunte by −90° en 90° binne hierdie interval gee. Die − 1 is buite die tan, dus skuif dit elke punt van die grafiek een eenheid af, maar om 'n prent af te skuif kan nie 'n vertikale lyn links of regs skuif nie, dus bly die asimptote presies waar hulle was. Dit is die nuttige onderskeid: 'n getal wat BUITE bygetel of afgetrek word, raak nooit aan 'n vertikale asimptoot nie, terwyl 'n getal binne die hakie by die x dit skuif. Skryf elke antwoord as x is gelyk aan 'n waarde; 'n kaal getal beskryf nie 'n lyn nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#33.en: Sketch the graph of h for  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°],  clearly showing the asymptotes, the y-intercept and the x-intercepts.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#33.af: Skets die grafiek van h vir  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°],  en toon die asimptote, die y-afsnit en die x-afsnitte duidelik aan.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#34.en: Draw the two dashed asymptotes first — they are the fence posts. Then plot where the graph cuts the y-axis, and where it cuts the x-axis (that is where tan x = 1).
tgraph-siblings-sketch#34.af: Teken eers die twee asimptote as stippellyne: hulle is die heiningpale. Stip dan waar die grafiek die y-as sny, en waar dit die x-as sny (dit is waar tan x = 1).

tgraph-siblings-sketch#35.en: Draw the asymptotes  x = −90°  and  x = 90°  as dashed vertical lines.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#35.af: Teken die asimptote  x = −90°  en  x = 90°  as vertikale stippellyne.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#37.en: x-intercepts:  tan x − 1 = 0  ⟹  tan x = 1  ⟹  x = 45°  and  x = −135°.  Three branches, each rising from its left asymptote to its right one.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#37.af: x-afsnitte:  tan x − 1 = 0  ⟹  tan x = 1  ⟹  x = 45°  en  x = −135°.  Drie takke, elkeen stygend van sy linkerasimptoot tot by sy regterasimptoot.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#38.en: REMEMBER: a tangent graph never touches an asymptote and never crosses one. Each branch must be drawn as a separate piece of curve — joining them across an asymptote turns a tangent graph into something that does not exist.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#38.af: ONTHOU: 'n tan-grafiek raak nooit aan 'n asimptoot nie en sny nooit een nie. Elke tak moet as 'n aparte stuk kurwe geteken word: as jy hulle oor 'n asimptoot verbind, word 'n tan-grafiek iets wat nie bestaan nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#39.en: Sketching a tangent is a different job from sketching a sine, so use a different order. The asymptotes come first, dashed, because they divide the interval into the separate branches you are going to draw. Between −180° and 180° the two asymptotes at −90° and 90° cut the interval into three pieces, so your sketch will have three branches. Then plot the two kinds of intercept. The y-intercept is a straight substitution: put x = 0 in and get −1. The x-intercepts need you to solve tan x = 1, which is 45° from the special angles, and then 45° − 180° = −135° for the branch on the left. Every branch climbs from bottom left to top right, and none of them touches a dashed line.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#39.af: Om 'n tan-grafiek te skets is 'n ander werk as om 'n sin-grafiek te skets, so gebruik 'n ander volgorde. Die asimptote kom eerste, as stippellyne, want hulle verdeel die interval in die aparte takke wat jy gaan teken. Tussen −180° en 180° sny die twee asimptote by −90° en 90° die interval in drie stukke, dus sal jou skets drie takke hê. Stip dan die twee soorte afsnitte. Die y-afsnit is 'n reguit vervanging: sit x = 0 in en kry −1. Vir die x-afsnitte moet jy tan x = 1 oplos, wat 45° is uit die spesiale hoeke, en dan 45° − 180° = −135° vir die tak links. Elke tak klim van links onder na regs bo, en nie een van hulle raak aan 'n stippellyn nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#40.en:
Consider the function  f(x) = −3 cos x.

Write down the amplitude of f.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#40.af:
Beskou die funksie  f(x) = −3 cos x.

Skryf die amplitude van f neer.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#41.en: Amplitude is a distance, so it is never negative. Take the size of the number in front.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#41.af: Amplitude is 'n afstand, dus is dit nooit negatief nie. Neem die grootte van die getal voor.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#44.en: The number in front of the cos does two separate jobs, and only one of them is the amplitude. Its SIZE is the amplitude, so the graph swings 3 units above and 3 units below the midline. Its SIGN flips the graph upside down, which changes where the graph is high and where it is low but not how far it goes. So the answer here is 3, not −3. Getting this straight before you sketch matters, because it tells you two useful things at once: your wave has to reach 3 and −3 on the y-axis, and it has to start at the BOTTOM on the y-axis rather than the top, which is the opposite of a plain cosine.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#44.af: Die getal voor die cos doen twee aparte take, en net een daarvan is die amplitude. Sy GROOTTE is die amplitude, dus swaai die grafiek 3 eenhede bo en 3 eenhede onder die middelste lyn. Sy TEKEN draai die grafiek onderstebo, wat verander waar die grafiek hoog en waar dit laag is, maar nie hoe ver dit gaan nie. Die antwoord hier is dus 3, nie −3 nie. Dit is belangrik om dit reg te kry voordat jy skets, want dit sê vir jou twee nuttige dinge tegelyk: jou golf moet 3 en −3 op die y-as bereik, en dit moet ONDER op die y-as begin eerder as bo, wat die teenoorgestelde van 'n gewone cos-grafiek is.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#45.en: A plain cosine starts at the top on the y-axis. The minus flips it, so this one starts at the bottom. Everything else about the rhythm stays the same.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#45.af: 'n Gewone cos-grafiek begin bo op die y-as. Die minus draai dit onderstebo, dus begin hierdie een onder. Alles anders aan die ritme bly dieselfde.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#46.en: The minus flips the cosine, so the y-axis value is a MINIMUM:  f(0) = −3(1) = −3  ⟹  (0 ; −3)
tgraph-siblings-sketch#46.af: Die minus draai die cos-grafiek onderstebo, dus is die waarde op die y-as 'n MINIMUM:  f(0) = −3(1) = −3  ⟹  (0 ; −3)

tgraph-siblings-sketch#48.en: Maxima at the ends of the interval:  (−180° ; 3) and (180° ; 3)
tgraph-siblings-sketch#48.af: Maksima by die eindpunte van die interval:  (−180° ; 3) en (180° ; 3)

tgraph-siblings-sketch#49.en: One smooth wave, amplitude 3, starting and ending at the top and dipping to −3 on the y-axis.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#49.af: Een gladde golf, amplitude 3, wat bo begin en eindig en op die y-as tot by −3 daal.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#50.en: WATCH OUT: the minus does not move the x-intercepts. Wherever the plain cosine crossed the x-axis, the flipped one crosses it too — the graph passes through the same points, it just arrives at them going the other way.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#50.af: PASOP: die minus skuif nie die x-afsnitte nie. Oral waar die gewone cos-grafiek die x-as gesny het, sny die gereflekteerde een dit ook: die grafiek gaan deur dieselfde punte, dit kom net uit die ander rigting daar aan.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#51.en: The quickest way to sketch a reflected graph is to sketch the plain one in your head first and then turn it over. A plain cosine starts at its maximum on the y-axis, falls to zero at 90°, drops to its minimum at 180° and comes back. Turning that upside down means this graph starts at its MINIMUM on the y-axis, rises to zero at 90° and reaches its maximum at 180°. The x-intercepts do not move at all, because a value of zero stays zero when you multiply it by −3. What does change is the height everywhere else, stretched to three times as far from the midline. Check your finished sketch against the y-axis: it should dip to −3 exactly where a plain cosine would have peaked.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#51.af: Die vinnigste manier om 'n gereflekteerde grafiek te skets, is om eers die gewone een in jou kop te skets en dit dan om te draai. 'n Gewone cos-grafiek begin by sy maksimum op die y-as, val na nul by 90°, daal tot by sy minimum by 180° en kom terug. As jy dit onderstebo draai, begin hierdie grafiek by sy MINIMUM op die y-as, styg na nul by 90° en bereik sy maksimum by 180°. Die x-afsnitte skuif glad nie, want 'n waarde van nul bly nul as jy dit met −3 vermenigvuldig. Wat wel verander, is die hoogte oral anders, gerek tot drie keer so ver van die middelste lyn af. Toets jou klaar skets teen die y-as: dit moet presies tot by −3 daal waar 'n gewone cos-grafiek sy piek sou hê.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#52.en:
Consider the function  f(x) = sin x + 2.

Sketch the graph of f for  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°],  clearly showing the turning points and the intercept with the y-axis.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#52.af:
Beskou die funksie  f(x) = sin x + 2.

Skets die grafiek van f vir  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°],  en toon die draaipunte en die afsnit met die y-as duidelik aan.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#53.en: Draw the midline first — the + 2 tells you where it is — and then build the wave one amplitude above and below it.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#53.af: Teken eers die middelste lyn (die + 2 sê vir jou waar dit is), en bou dan die golf een amplitude bo en onder dit.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#54.en: The  + 2  lifts the whole graph, so the midline is  y = 2  and the amplitude is 1.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#54.af: Die  + 2  lig die hele grafiek, dus is die middelste lyn  y = 2  en is die amplitude 1.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#57.en: One smooth wave rocking about  y = 2,  from 1 up to 3, across the whole interval.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#57.af: Een gladde golf rondom  y = 2,  van 1 op tot by 3, oor die hele interval.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#58.en: Whenever a number is added on the end, draw the midline before you draw anything else. It is a faint horizontal line at y = 2 here, and once it is on the page the rest of the sketch is exactly the plain sine graph you already know, just measured from that line instead of from the x-axis. Start on the midline at the y-axis, rise one amplitude to a maximum at 90°, come back to the midline at 180°, and mirror the same rhythm going left to a minimum at −90°. The amplitude is 1, so the top of the wave is at 3 and the bottom is at 1. Learners who skip the midline usually end up drawing the wave about the x-axis and then trying to shift it afterwards, which is where the mistakes creep in.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#58.af: Wanneer daar 'n getal aan die einde bygetel word, teken die middelste lyn voordat jy enigiets anders teken. Hier is dit 'n ligte horisontale lyn by y = 2, en sodra dit op die bladsy is, is die res van die skets presies die gewone sin-grafiek wat jy reeds ken, net gemeet vanaf daardie lyn in plaas van vanaf die x-as. Begin op die middelste lyn by die y-as, styg een amplitude tot by 'n maksimum by 90°, kom terug na die middelste lyn by 180°, en volg dieselfde ritme na links tot by 'n minimum by −90°. Die amplitude is 1, dus is die top van die golf by 3 en die bodem by 1. Leerders wat die middelste lyn oorslaan, teken gewoonlik die golf om die x-as en probeer dit dan agterna skuif, en dis waar die foute insluip.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#59.en: Explain why the graph of f has no x-intercepts.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#59.af: Verduidelik hoekom die grafiek van f geen x-afsnitte het nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#60.en: An x-intercept happens where y = 0. Ask yourself what the smallest value f can ever take is, and compare it with 0.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#60.af: 'n x-afsnit is waar y = 0. Vra jouself wat die kleinste waarde is wat f ooit kan aanneem, en vergelyk dit met 0.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#61.en: The smallest value of  sin x  is −1, so the smallest value of f is  −1 + 2 = 1.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#61.af: Die kleinste waarde van  sin x  is −1, dus is die kleinste waarde van f  −1 + 2 = 1.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#62.en: The range is  y ∈ [1 ; 3],  so f never reaches 0 — the whole graph lies above the x-axis, and therefore it has no x-intercepts.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#62.af: Die waardeversameling is  y ∈ [1 ; 3],  dus bereik f nooit 0 nie: die hele grafiek lê bo die x-as, en daarom het dit geen x-afsnitte nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#63.en: REMEMBER: \"explain\" wants a REASON, not a drawing. Saying \"because the graph does not touch the x-axis\" just repeats the question. The reason is that the lowest value the function can take is 1, and 1 is above 0.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#63.af: ONTHOU: \"verduidelik\" vra 'n REDE, nie 'n tekening nie. Om te sê \"want die grafiek raak nie aan die x-as nie\" herhaal net die vraag. Die rede is dat die laagste waarde wat die funksie kan aanneem 1 is, en 1 is bo 0.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#64.en: An x-intercept is a place where the output of the function is zero, so the question is really asking whether f can ever equal 0. The largest and smallest values of sin x are 1 and −1, and that never changes no matter what x you feed it. Adding 2 pushes those two extremes up to 3 and 1, so the whole function is trapped between 1 and 3. Zero is not in that interval, so there is no x that makes f equal zero, and the graph never crosses the axis. Writing the range down is the cleanest way to say all of that in one line. This kind of argument comes up again and again in trig — the fact that sine and cosine are locked between −1 and 1 is what makes equations like sin x = 2 impossible.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#64.af: 'n x-afsnit is 'n plek waar die uitset van die funksie nul is, dus vra die vraag eintlik of f ooit gelyk aan 0 kan wees. Die grootste en kleinste waardes van sin x is 1 en −1, en dit verander nooit nie, maak nie saak watter x jy invoer nie. As jy 2 bytel, skuif daardie twee uiterstes op na 3 en 1, dus is die hele funksie vasgevang tussen 1 en 3. Nul is nie in daardie interval nie, dus is daar geen x wat f gelyk aan nul maak nie, en die grafiek sny nooit die as nie. Om die waardeversameling neer te skryf, is die netjiesste manier om dit alles in een reël te sê. Hierdie soort argument kom telkens weer in trig voor: die feit dat sin en cos tussen −1 en 1 vasgevang is, maak vergelykings soos sin x = 2 onmoontlik.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#65.en:
Consider the functions  f(x) = sin 2x  and  g(x) = cos x.

On the same set of axes, sketch the graphs of f and g for  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°],  clearly showing the intercepts with the axes and the turning points of each graph. Label each graph.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#65.af:
Beskou die funksies  f(x) = sin 2x  en  g(x) = cos x.

Skets die grafieke van f en g op dieselfde assestelsel vir  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°],  en toon die afsnitte met die asse en die draaipunte van elke grafiek duidelik aan. Benoem elke grafiek.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#66.en: Work out each graph's period first, so you know how many waves of each have to fit. Then draw them one at a time, and label them — an unlabelled pair of curves cannot be marked.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#66.af: Werk eers elke grafiek se periode uit, sodat jy weet hoeveel golwe van elk moet pas. Teken hulle dan een op 'n slag, en benoem hulle: 'n paar kurwes sonder name kan nie nagesien word nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#67.en: f:  period = 360° ÷ 2 = 180°,  so TWO complete waves fit the interval. x-intercepts at −180°, −90°, 0°, 90°, 180°; maximum (45° ; 1); minimum (135° ; −1) — and their mirror images on the left.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#67.af: f:  periode = 360° ÷ 2 = 180°,  dus pas TWEE volledige golwe in die interval. x-afsnitte by −180°, −90°, 0°, 90°, 180°; maksimum (45° ; 1); minimum (135° ; −1), en hul gereflekteerde beelde aan die linkerkant.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#68.en: g:  period = 360°,  so ONE complete wave fits. Maximum (0 ; 1); minima at (−180° ; −1) and (180° ; −1); x-intercepts at −90° and 90°.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#68.af: g:  periode = 360°,  dus pas EEN volledige golf. Maksimum (0 ; 1); minima by (−180° ; −1) en (180° ; −1); x-afsnitte by −90° en 90°.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#69.en: Both curves drawn to the same scale on one set of axes, each one labelled f or g.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#69.af: Albei kurwes op dieselfde skaal op een assestelsel geteken, elkeen benoem as f of g.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#70.en: WATCH OUT: the two graphs must be to the SAME scale on the SAME axes. Drawing f small and g large, or forgetting the labels, throws away marks even when both shapes are right — and it makes the next part impossible to answer.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#70.af: PASOP: die twee grafieke moet op DIESELFDE skaal op DIESELFDE asse wees. As jy f klein en g groot teken, of vergeet om hulle te benoem, gooi jy punte weg selfs al is albei vorms reg, en dan kan die volgende deel nie beantwoord word nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#71.en: Two graphs on one set of axes is really two separate sketching jobs plus one piece of care. Do the jobs one at a time. Work out f's period, which is 180°, so two waves fit; find its landmarks by quartering that period; draw it and label it. Then do the same for g, whose period is the plain 360°, so only one wave fits. The piece of care is the scale: both curves must be measured against the same y-axis, otherwise the picture stops telling the truth about where they cross, and crossings are almost always what the next part asks about. Labelling matters for the same reason — a question about f is unanswerable if the marker cannot tell which curve you meant. Notice both graphs happen to pass through the x-axis at −90° and 90°, which is a real feature and not a drawing error.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#71.af: Twee grafieke op een assestelsel is eintlik twee aparte sketswerkies plus een ding om mee op te pas. Doen die werkies een op 'n slag. Werk f se periode uit, wat 180° is, dus pas twee golwe; vind sy herkenbare punte deur daardie periode in vier te deel; teken dit en benoem dit. Doen dan dieselfde vir g, waarvan die periode die gewone 360° is, dus pas net een golf. Die ding om mee op te pas, is die skaal: albei kurwes moet teen dieselfde y-as gemeet word, anders vertel die prent nie meer die waarheid oor waar hulle sny nie, en snypunte is byna altyd waaroor die volgende deel vra. Benoeming is om dieselfde rede belangrik: 'n vraag oor f kan nie beantwoord word as die nasiener nie kan sien watter kurwe jy bedoel nie. Let op dat albei grafieke toevallig by −90° en 90° deur die x-as gaan, wat 'n regte kenmerk is en nie 'n tekenfout nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#72.en: Use your sketch to write down the number of solutions of  sin 2x = cos x  for  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°].
tgraph-siblings-sketch#72.af: Gebruik jou skets om die aantal oplossings van  sin 2x = cos x  vir  x ∈ [−180° ; 180°] neer te skryf.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#73.en: Two graphs are equal exactly where they cut each other. You do not have to solve anything — count the crossings on your own sketch.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#73.af: Twee grafieke is presies gelyk waar hulle mekaar sny. Jy hoef niks op te los nie: tel die snypunte op jou eie skets.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#74.en: sin 2x = cos x  means  f(x) = g(x),  which happens wherever the two curves cut each other.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#74.af: sin 2x = cos x  beteken  f(x) = g(x),  wat oral gebeur waar die twee kurwes mekaar sny.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#75.en: The curves cut at four places in the interval  ∴  there are 4 solutions.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#75.af: Die kurwes sny op vier plekke in die interval  ∴  daar is 4 oplossings.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#76.en: REMEMBER: a point where the two graphs merely touch the x-axis at the same moment still counts as a crossing — at x = −90° and x = 90° both graphs are at zero, so they really are equal there. Count every place the curves meet, not only the obvious ones.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#76.af: ONTHOU: 'n punt waar die twee grafieke net gelyktydig aan die x-as raak, tel steeds as 'n snypunt: by x = −90° en x = 90° is albei grafieke op nul, dus is hulle regtig daar gelyk. Tel elke plek waar die kurwes ontmoet, nie net die ooglopende nie.

tgraph-siblings-sketch#77.en: Whenever a question asks how many solutions an equation has and you have both graphs in front of you, the answer is a counting job rather than an algebra job. Two functions are equal exactly where their graphs meet, so every crossing point is one solution and there are no others. On this pair there are four: two of them are the places where both curves pass through zero together, at −90° and 90°, and the other two are ordinary crossings, one on each side of 90°. Do not try to solve this equation algebraically — turning sin 2x into something you can work with needs the double-angle formula, which is Grade 12 work. Reading the answer off an honest, to-scale sketch is the intended method here.
tgraph-siblings-sketch#77.af: Wanneer 'n vraag vra hoeveel oplossings 'n vergelyking het en jy albei grafieke voor jou het, is die antwoord 'n teltaak eerder as 'n algebrataak. Twee funksies is presies gelyk waar hul grafieke ontmoet, dus is elke snypunt een oplossing en daar is geen ander nie. By hierdie paar is daar vier: twee daarvan is die plekke waar albei kurwes saam deur nul gaan, by −90° en 90°, en die ander twee is gewone snypunte, een aan elke kant van 90°. Moenie probeer om hierdie vergelyking algebraïes op te los nie: om sin 2x in iets te verander waarmee jy kan werk, het die dubbelhoekformule nodig, en dit is Graad 12-werk. Om die antwoord van 'n eerlike skets op skaal af te lees, is hier die bedoelde metode.

questgt11-six-types#2.en: isolate the function, then ref ∠ and quadrants — and don't type − into the calculator.
questgt11-six-types#2.af: isoleer die funksie, dan verwysingshoek en kwadrante, en moenie − in die sakrekenaar intik nie.

questgt11-six-types#4.en: same angle on both sides — divide away with cos θ and it turns into a tan.
questgt11-six-types#4.af: dieselfde hoek aan albei kante: deel deur cos θ en dit word 'n tan.

questgt11-six-types#7.en: take the common factor out, then each bracket separately = 0 — and take 0 as +.
questgt11-six-types#7.af: haal die gemene faktor uit, dan elke hakie apart = 0, en neem 0 as +.

questgt11-six-types#9.en: four terms — group them in pairs, and the brackets left over must come out the same.
questgt11-six-types#9.af: vier terme: groepeer hulle in pare, en die hakies wat oorbly moet dieselfde uitkom.

questgt11-six-types#11.en: three terms, one function squared and one not — K-method, and a masked identity if the middle term differs.
questgt11-six-types#11.af: drie terme, een funksie in die kwadraat en een nie: K-metode, en 'n gemaskerde identiteit as die middelterm verskil.

questgt11-six-types#12.en: trinomial (K-method) · trinomial with a masked identity

questgt11-six-types#14.en: sin and cos with different ∠s — make both the same function. No ref. ∠ here.
questgt11-six-types#14.af: sin en cos met verskillende ∠e: maak albei dieselfde funksie. Geen verwysingshoek hier nie.

questgt11-six-types#16.en:
${eqHtml(eq, L)}
Which of the six types is this?
questgt11-six-types#16.af:
${eqHtml(eq, L)}
Watter een van die ses tipes is dit?

questgt1-intro#4.en:
SOH — Sine · Opposite · Hypotenuse
sin θ = O/H
questgt1-intro#4.af:
SOH: sin · teenoorstaande (O) · skuinssy (H)
sin θ = O/H

questgt1-intro#5.en:
CAH — Cosine · Adjacent · Hypotenuse
cos θ = A/H
questgt1-intro#5.af:
CAH: cos · aangrensende (A) · skuinssy (H)
cos θ = A/H

questgt1-intro#6.en:
TOA — Tangent · Opposite · Adjacent
tan θ = O/A
questgt1-intro#6.af:
TOA: tan · teenoorstaande (O) · aangrensende (A)
tan θ = O/A

questgt1-intro#7.en: As the point moves along the circle (now at θ = ${d}°) the radius stays the same — but θ, the x-coordinate and the y-coordinate all change.
questgt1-intro#7.af: Soos die punt langs die sirkel beweeg (nou by θ = ${d}°), bly die radius dieselfde, maar θ, die x-koördinaat en die y-koördinaat verander almal.

questgt1-intro#8.en: So trigonometry is the study of…
questgt1-intro#8.af: Trigonometrie is dus die studie van…

questgt1-intro#9.en: angles and the angle relationships of triangles
questgt1-intro#9.af: hoeke en die hoekverwantskappe van driehoeke

questgt1-intro#12.en: the sides of a right triangle, never the angles
questgt1-intro#12.af: die sye van 'n reghoekige driehoek, nooit die hoeke nie

questgt1-intro#13.en: Put the three pieces together: three · angled · measurement.
questgt1-intro#13.af: Sit die drie stukke saam: drie · hoekig · meting.

questgt1-intro#14.en: tri (three) + gono (angled) + metry (measurement) = the study of angles and of the angular relationships of triangles.
questgt1-intro#14.af: tri (drie) + gono (hoekig) + metrie (meting) = die studie van hoeke en van die hoekverwantskappe van driehoeke.

questgt1-intro#15.en: Trig ratios (SOHCAHTOA) can only be used with right triangles. True or false?
questgt1-intro#15.af: Trig-verhoudings (SOHCAHTOA) kan net in reghoekige driehoeke gebruik word. Waar of onwaar?

questgt1-intro#16.en: The boxed rule from class: ratios can ONLY be used with right triangles.
questgt1-intro#16.af: Die reël in die blokkie uit die klas: verhoudings kan NET in reghoekige driehoeke gebruik word.

questgt1-intro#17.en: True — SOHCAHTOA only works inside a right triangle.
questgt1-intro#17.af: Waar: SOHCAHTOA werk net binne 'n reghoekige driehoek.

questgt1-intro#18.en: Tap the side that is OPPOSITE θ.
questgt1-intro#18.af: Klik op die sy wat TEENOOR θ lê.

questgt1-intro#19.en: Tap the side that is ADJACENT to θ.
questgt1-intro#19.af: Klik op die sy wat AANGRENSEND aan θ is.

questgt1-intro#22.en: Adjacent = the side “next to” θ (not the hypotenuse).
questgt1-intro#22.af: Aangrensende = die sy “langs” θ (nie die skuinssy nie).

questgt1-intro#23.en: The hypotenuse is “across from” the right angle.
questgt1-intro#23.af: Die skuinssy is “oorkant” die regte hoek.

questgt1-intro#24.en: Opposite θ is the side straight across from it.
questgt1-intro#24.af: Teenoor θ is die sy reg oorkant hom.

questgt1-intro#25.en: Adjacent to θ is the side that touches θ but isn't the hypotenuse.
questgt1-intro#25.af: Aangrensend aan θ is die sy wat θ raak, maar nie die skuinssy is nie.

questgt1-intro#26.en: The hypotenuse is across from the right angle — the longest side, and it never touches it.
questgt1-intro#26.af: Die skuinssy is oorkant die regte hoek: die langste sy, en dit raak die regte hoek nooit nie.

questgt1-intro#27.en: Opposite = across from θ; adjacent = next to θ; hypotenuse = across from the right angle.
questgt1-intro#27.af: Teenoorstaande = oorkant θ; aangrensende = langs θ; skuinssy = oorkant die regte hoek.

questgt1-intro#36.en: SOH · CAH · TOA — sine is O/H, cosine is A/H, tangent is O/A.
questgt1-intro#36.af: SOH · CAH · TOA: sin is O/H, cos is A/H, tan is O/A.

questgt1-intro#38.en: What stays the same as the point moves round the circle?
questgt1-intro#38.af: Wat bly dieselfde terwyl die punt om die sirkel skuif?

questgt1-intro#43.en: Everything changes except one thing — the length from the centre to the point.
questgt1-intro#43.af: Alles verander behalwe een ding: die lengte van die middelpunt na die punt.

questgt1-intro#44.en: The radius r stays the same — only θ, x and y change. That's why a ratio needs its angle: fix r, move the point, watch x and y.
questgt1-intro#44.af: Die radius r bly dieselfde: net θ, x en y verander. Daarom het 'n verhouding sy hoek nodig: hou r vas, skuif die punt, kyk na x en y.

questgt1-intro#50.en: sin is the y-coordinate over the radius.
questgt1-intro#50.af: sin is die y-koördinaat oor die radius.

questgt1-intro#51.en: sin θ = y/r — how the y-coordinate changes as θ changes (r stays the same).
questgt1-intro#51.af: sin θ = y/r: hoe die y-koördinaat verander soos θ verander (r bly dieselfde).

questgt1-intro#54.en: cos is the x-coordinate over the radius.
questgt1-intro#54.af: cos is die x-koördinaat oor die radius.

questgt1-intro#55.en: cos θ = x/r — how the x-coordinate changes as θ changes.
questgt1-intro#55.af: cos θ = x/r: hoe die x-koördinaat verander soos θ verander.

questgt1-intro#57.en: tan compares the y- and x-coordinates directly — no r involved.
questgt1-intro#57.af: tan vergelyk die y- en x-koördinate direk: geen r nie.

questgt1-intro#58.en: tan θ = y/x = sin θ / cos θ.
questgt1-intro#58.af: tan θ = y/x = sin θ / cos θ.

questgt1-intro#59.en: On the circle (r fixed): as the x-value gets bigger, the y-value gets smaller — and the other way round. True or false?
questgt1-intro#59.af: Op die sirkel (r vas): soos die x-waarde groter word, word die y-waarde kleiner, en andersom. Waar of onwaar?

questgt1-intro#60.en: Think of the point on the circle: r is fixed, so when x grows, y has to shrink.
questgt1-intro#60.af: Dink aan die punt op die sirkel: r is vas, dus as x groei, moet y krimp.

questgt1-intro#61.en: True — as x grows, y shrinks (and back). That's exactly what tan θ = y/x is tracking.
questgt1-intro#61.af: Waar: soos x groei, krimp y (en andersom). Dit is presies wat tan θ = y/x dophou.

questgt1-intro#62.en: Blip says: “the sine is 0,6.” What does that number tell you on its own?
questgt1-intro#62.af: Blip sê: “die sin is 0,6.” Wat sê daardie getal op sy eie vir jou?

questgt1-intro#63.en: Nothing until you know the angle — a ratio only means something for its θ
questgt1-intro#63.af: Niks totdat jy die hoek ken nie: 'n verhouding beteken net iets vir sy θ

questgt1-intro#67.en: A ratio is a relationship, not a length or an angle by itself.
questgt1-intro#67.af: 'n Verhouding is 'n verwantskap, nie 'n lengte of 'n hoek op sy eie nie.

questgt1-intro#68.en: Fix the radius, move the point, watch x and y — the ratio IS the angle. On its own, 0,6 means nothing.
questgt1-intro#68.af: Hou die radius vas, skuif die punt, kyk na x en y: die verhouding IS die hoek. Op sy eie beteken 0,6 niks.

questgt2-cartesian#14.en: r is a radius, so it is never negative — the sign of sin follows y alone: y is + above the x-axis (① and ②), − below it (③ and ④)
questgt2-cartesian#14.af: r is 'n radius en nooit negatief nie, dus volg die teken van sin net y: y is + bo die x-as (① en ②), − daaronder (③ en ④)

questgt2-cartesian#15.en: r is a radius, so it is never negative — the sign of cos follows x alone: x is + on the right (① and ④), − on the left (② and ③)
questgt2-cartesian#15.af: r is 'n radius en nooit negatief nie, dus volg die teken van cos net x: x is + regs (① en ④), − links (② en ③)

questgt2-cartesian#16.en: tan = y/x has no r in it: it is + when x and y carry the SAME sign (① and ③), − when they differ (② and ④)
questgt2-cartesian#16.af: tan = y/x het geen r nie: dit is + as x en y DIESELFDE teken het (① en ③), − as hulle verskil (② en ④)

questgt3-special#1.en: Where they come from: cut a square corner to corner and you get 45-45-90; cut an equilateral triangle straight down the middle and you get 30-60-90.
questgt3-special#1.af: Waar hulle vandaan kom: sny 'n vierkant van hoek tot hoek en jy kry 45-45-90; sny 'n gelyksydige driehoek reguit deur die middel en jy kry 30-60-90.

questgt3-special#2.en: Take an equilateral triangle with sides of 2 and cut it straight down the middle
questgt3-special#2.af: Neem 'n gelyksydige driehoek met sye van 2 en sny dit reg middeldeur

questgt3-special#3.en: that cut is where the 30-60-90 comes from
questgt3-special#3.af: daardie snit is waar die 30-60-90 vandaan kom

questgt3-special#4.en: Take a square with sides of 1 and cut it corner to corner
questgt3-special#4.af: Neem 'n vierkant met sye van 1 en sny dit van hoek tot hoek

questgt3-special#5.en: that cut is where the 45-45-90 comes from
questgt3-special#5.af: daardie snit is waar die 45-45-90 vandaan kom

questgt3-special#6.en: In the 30-60-90 triangle, the side opposite 30° is…
questgt3-special#6.af: In die 30-60-90-driehoek is die sy teenoor 30°…

questgt3-special#7.en: The cut halves the 60° top angle into 30°, and halves the base of 2 into 1
questgt3-special#7.af: Die snit halveer die boonste hoek van 60° na 30°, en halveer die basis van 2 na 1

questgt3-special#8.en: That half-base lies straight across from the 30° corner, so it is 1
questgt3-special#8.af: Daardie halwe basis lê reg oorkant die 30°-hoek, dus is dit 1

questgt3-special#9.en: In the 30-60-90 triangle, the side opposite 60° is…
questgt3-special#9.af: In die 30-60-90-driehoek is die sy teenoor 60°…

questgt3-special#12.en: height = √3, and it sits across from the 60° corner, so that side is √3
questgt3-special#12.af: hoogte = √3, en dit lê oorkant die 60°-hoek, dus is daardie sy √3

questgt3-special#13.en: In the 30-60-90 triangle, the side opposite 90° (the hypotenuse) is…
questgt3-special#13.af: In die 30-60-90-driehoek is die sy teenoor 90° (die skuinssy)…

questgt3-special#14.en: The cut does not touch the slanted side — it is still a whole side of the equilateral triangle
questgt3-special#14.af: Die snit raak nie die skuins sy nie: dit is steeds 'n hele sy van die gelyksydige driehoek

questgt3-special#15.en: That slanted side faces the right angle, so the hypotenuse is 2
questgt3-special#15.af: Daardie skuins sy kyk na die regte hoek, dus is die skuinssy 2

questgt3-special#16.en: In the 45-45-90 triangle, the side opposite a 45° angle is…
questgt3-special#16.af: In die 45-45-90-driehoek is die sy teenoor 'n 45°-hoek…

questgt3-special#17.en: The two short sides of the new triangle are just sides of the square, so each is 1
questgt3-special#17.af: Die twee kort sye van die nuwe driehoek is net sye van die vierkant, dus is elkeen 1

questgt3-special#18.en: Each of them faces one of the 45° corners, so that side is 1
questgt3-special#18.af: Elkeen kyk na een van die 45°-hoeke, dus is daardie sy 1

questgt3-special#19.en: In the 45-45-90 triangle, the side opposite 90° (the hypotenuse) is…
questgt3-special#19.af: In die 45-45-90-driehoek is die sy teenoor 90° (die skuinssy)…

questgt3-special#20.en: The two short sides are 1 and 1, so hyp² = 1² + 1² = 2
questgt3-special#20.af: Die twee kort sye is 1 en 1, dus skuinssy² = 1² + 1² = 2

questgt3-special#21.en: hyp = √2, and it faces the right angle, so the hypotenuse is √2
questgt3-special#21.af: skuinssy = √2, en dit kyk na die regte hoek, dus is die skuinssy √2

quest04-skewness#10.en: The skew is named for the tail — the longer whisker / bigger half.
quest04-skewness#10.af: Die skeefheid word na die stert genoem: die langer snor / groter helfte.

quest04-skewness#11.en: The bars are roughly symmetric about the centre → normal.
quest04-skewness#11.af: Die stawe is omtrent simmetries om die middel → normaal.

quest04-skewness#12.en: The tall bars are on the ${skew === "toRight" ? "left" : "right"} and the low tail stretches ${DIR[skew]} → skewed ${DIR[skew]}.
quest04-skewness#12.af: Die hoë stawe is ${skew === "toRight" ? "links" : "regs"} en die lae stert strek na ${DIR[skew]} → skeef na ${DIR[skew]}.

quest04-skewness#13.en: Look at the histogram. How is the distribution skewed?
quest04-skewness#13.af: Kyk na die histogram. Hoe is die verspreiding skeef?

quest04-skewness#15.en: Find the long low tail — the skew is named for it.
quest04-skewness#15.af: Vind die lang, lae stert: die skeefheid word daarna genoem.

quest04-skewness#17.en: The curve rises steeply early then flattens at the top — the thin tail is on the right → skewed right.
quest04-skewness#17.af: Die kurwe styg vroeg steil en word dan bo plat: die dun stert is regs → skeef na regs.

quest04-skewness#18.en: The curve stays flat then rises steeply at the top — the thin tail is on the left → skewed left.
quest04-skewness#18.af: Die kurwe bly plat en styg dan bo steil: die dun stert is links → skeef na links.

quest04-skewness#19.en: Look at the ogive. How is the distribution skewed?
quest04-skewness#19.af: Kyk na die ogief. Hoe is die verspreiding skeef?

quest04-skewness#21.en: The flat end of the ogive is the tail.
quest04-skewness#21.af: Die plat deel van die ogief is die stert.

quest04-skewness#25.en: For a data set, the mean x̄ = ${m} and the median = ${med}. How is it skewed?
quest04-skewness#25.af: Vir 'n datastel is die gemiddelde x̄ = ${m} en die mediaan = ${med}. Hoe is dit skeef?

quest04-skewness#26.en: Compare the mean and median — the mean is pulled toward the tail.
quest04-skewness#26.af: Vergelyk die gemiddelde en mediaan: die gemiddelde word na die stert getrek.

quest04-skewness#27.en: ${rel} → ${skew === "noSkew" ? "symmetric" : "skewed " + DIR[skew]} (the mean is pulled toward the tail).
quest04-skewness#27.af: ${rel} → ${skew === "noSkew" ? "simmetries" : "skeef na " + DIR[skew]} (die gemiddelde word na die stert getrek).

quest04-skewness#28.en: Most of the data is bunched together, with a long thin tail to the ${DIR[dir]}. How is the distribution described?
quest04-skewness#28.af: Die meeste van die data lê dig bymekaar, met 'n lang, dun stert na ${DIR[dir]}. Hoe beskryf jy die verspreiding?

quest04-skewness#29.en: The skew is named for the tail.
quest04-skewness#29.af: Die skeefheid word na die stert genoem.

quest04-skewness#30.en: The tail points ${DIR[dir]} → skewed to the ${DIR[dir]}.
quest04-skewness#30.af: Die stert wys na ${DIR[dir]} → skeef na ${DIR[dir]}.

quest04-skewness#31.en: Which statement is true for a distribution that is ${skew === "noSkew" ? "symmetric (normal)" : "skewed to the " + DIR[skew]}?
quest04-skewness#31.af: Watter stelling is waar vir 'n verspreiding wat ${skew === "noSkew" ? "simmetries (normaal)" : "skeef na " + DIR[skew]} is?

quest04-skewness#32.en: Skew toward the tail pulls the mean past the median.
quest04-skewness#32.af: Skeefheid na die stert trek die gemiddelde verby die mediaan.

quest08-mixed#11.en: Every value in a data set is increased by ${k}. What happens to the ${m.name}?
quest08-mixed#11.af: Elke waarde in 'n datastel word met ${k} vermeerder. Wat gebeur met die ${m.name}?

quest08-mixed#12.en: Adding the same number to every value shifts the centre but not the spread.
quest08-mixed#12.af: As jy dieselfde getal by elke waarde tel, skuif die sentrum, maar nie die spreiding nie.

quest08-mixed#14.en: Spread is unchanged — the ${m.name} stays the same.
quest08-mixed#14.af: Die spreiding verander nie: die ${m.name} bly dieselfde.

quest08-mixed#15.en: The mean of a data set is ${M}. If ${k} is ${add ? "added to" : "subtracted from"} every value, what is the new mean?
quest08-mixed#15.af: Die gemiddelde van 'n datastel is ${M}. As ${k} ${add ? "by elke waarde opgetel" : "van elke waarde afgetrek"} word, wat is die nuwe gemiddelde?

quest08-mixed#16.en: The mean shifts by the same amount you add to (or subtract from) every value.
quest08-mixed#16.af: Die gemiddelde skuif met dieselfde hoeveelheid wat jy by elke waarde tel (of van elke waarde aftrek).

quest08-mixed#19.en: A data set has standard deviation σ = ${C(sd)}. Every value is increased by ${k}. What is the new standard deviation?
quest08-mixed#19.af: 'n Datastel het standaardafwyking σ = ${C(sd)}. Elke waarde word met ${k} vermeerder. Wat is die nuwe standaardafwyking?

quest08-mixed#20.en: Shifting every value sideways does not change how spread out the data is.
quest08-mixed#20.af: As jy elke waarde links of regs skuif, verander dit nie hoe uitgesprei die data is nie.

quest08-mixed#21.en: Adding a constant leaves the spread unchanged → σ stays ${C(sd)}.
quest08-mixed#21.af: 'n Konstante bytel laat die spreiding onveranderd → σ bly ${C(sd)}.

quest08-mixed#26.en: The median is the line inside each box — which sits further right?
quest08-mixed#26.af: Die mediaan is die lyn binne elke mond: watter een lê verder regs?

quest08-mixed#27.en: ${correct} has its median line further along the scale.
quest08-mixed#27.af: ${correct} se mediaanlyn lê verder langs die skaal.

quest08-mixed#28.en: Which set is more spread out (larger range)?

quest08-mixed#30.en: Range = distance from the left whisker end to the right whisker end.
quest08-mixed#30.af: Omvang = afstand van die punt van die linkersnor tot die punt van die regtersnor.

quest08-mixed#31.en: ${correct} stretches further from minimum to maximum → larger range.
quest08-mixed#31.af: ${correct} strek verder van minimum tot maksimum → groter omvang.

quest08-mixed#32.en: A data set has an IQR of ${iqrV} and Q1 = ${q1}. Find Q3.
quest08-mixed#32.af: 'n Datastel het 'n interkwartielomvang van ${iqrV} en Q1 = ${q1}. Vind Q3.

quest08-mixed#33.en: IQR = Q3 − Q1, so Q3 = Q1 + IQR.
quest08-mixed#33.af: Interkwartielomvang = Q3 − Q1, dus Q3 = Q1 + interkwartielomvang.

quest08-mixed#36.en: A data set has an IQR of ${iqrV} and Q3 = ${q3}. Find Q1.
quest08-mixed#36.af: 'n Datastel het 'n interkwartielomvang van ${iqrV} en Q3 = ${q3}. Vind Q1.

quest08-mixed#37.en: IQR = Q3 − Q1, so Q1 = Q3 − IQR.
quest08-mixed#37.af: Interkwartielomvang = Q3 − Q1, dus Q1 = Q3 − interkwartielomvang.

quest08-mixed#39.en: A data set has variance ${v}. Every value is increased by ${k}. What is the new variance?
quest08-mixed#39.af: 'n Datastel het variansie ${v}. Elke waarde word met ${k} vermeerder. Wat is die nuwe variansie?

quest08-mixed#40.en: Adding a constant doesn’t change the spread — so the variance is unchanged.
quest08-mixed#40.af: 'n Konstante bytel verander nie die spreiding nie, dus bly die variansie onveranderd.

quest08-mixed#41.en: Adding a constant leaves the spread unchanged → variance stays ${v}.
quest08-mixed#41.af: 'n Konstante bytel laat die spreiding onveranderd → variansie bly ${v}.

questp1-basics#7.en: A fair ${N}-sided die is rolled once. How many outcomes are in the sample space, n(S)?
questp1-basics#7.af: 'n Regverdige ${N}-kantige dobbelsteen word een keer gegooi. Hoeveel uitkomste is in die uitkomsruimte, n(S)?

questp1-basics#8.en: The sample space is every value the die could land on.
questp1-basics#8.af: Die uitkomsruimte is elke waarde waarop die dobbelsteen kan land.

questp1-basics#11.en: A fair ${N}-sided die is rolled. How many outcomes give ${e.desc}? (that is n(E))
questp1-basics#11.af: 'n Regverdige ${N}-kantige dobbelsteen word gegooi. Hoeveel uitkomste gee ${e.desc}? (dit is n(E))

questp1-basics#12.en: List the values that fit, then count them.
questp1-basics#12.af: Lys die waardes wat pas, en tel hulle dan.

questp1-basics#15.en: A fair ${N}-sided die is rolled. Write P(${e.desc}) as a fraction in simplest form.
questp1-basics#15.af: 'n Regverdige ${N}-kantige dobbelsteen word gegooi. Skryf P(${e.desc}) as 'n breuk in eenvoudigste vorm.

questp1-basics#19.en: A fair ${N}-sided die is rolled. Write P(${e.desc}) as a decimal (2 places).
questp1-basics#19.af: 'n Regverdige ${N}-kantige dobbelsteen word gegooi. Skryf P(${e.desc}) as 'n desimale getal (2 plekke).

questp1-basics#20.en: Work out n(E) / n(S), then divide it out.
questp1-basics#20.af: Skryf n(E) / n(S) en deel dit dan uit.

questp1-basics#22.en: A fair ${N}-sided die is rolled. Write P(${e.desc}) as a percentage${pdp ? " (1 decimal place)" : ""}.
questp1-basics#22.af: 'n Regverdige ${N}-kantige dobbelsteen word gegooi. Skryf P(${e.desc}) as 'n persentasie${pdp ? " (1 desimale plek)" : ""}.

questp1-basics#23.en: Find P as a decimal, then × 100 for a percentage.
questp1-basics#23.af: Kry P as 'n desimale getal, en dan × 100 vir 'n persentasie.

questp1-basics#30.en: An experiment is run ${total} times and "${thing}" happens ${hits} times. What is the relative frequency of "${thing}"? (decimal, 2 places)
questp1-basics#30.af: 'n Eksperiment word ${total} keer uitgevoer en "${thing}" gebeur ${hits} keer. Wat is die relatiewe frekwensie van "${thing}"? (desimaal, 2 plekke)

questp1-basics#31.en: relative frequency = times it happened ÷ total trials.
questp1-basics#31.af: relatiewe frekwensie = kere wat dit gebeur het ÷ totale aantal proewe.

questp1-basics#33.en: Which one is worked out before doing any experiment — just from the possible outcomes?
questp1-basics#33.af: Watter een word voor enige eksperiment uitgewerk, net uit die moontlike uitkomste?

questp1-basics#37.af: geen van albei: albei het eers data nodig

questp1-basics#38.en: One is a prediction; the other is what actually happened.
questp1-basics#38.af: Een is 'n voorspelling; die ander is wat werklik gebeur het.

questp1-basics#39.en: Theoretical probability is the prediction; relative frequency comes from real data.
questp1-basics#39.af: Teoretiese waarskynlikheid is die voorspelling; relatiewe frekwensie kom uit werklike data.

questp1-basics#41.en: A probability must lie between 0 and 1. Which of these cannot be a probability?
questp1-basics#41.af: 'n Waarskynlikheid moet tussen 0 en 1 lê. Watter een hiervan kan nie 'n waarskynlikheid wees nie?

questp1-basics#42.en: 0 = impossible, 1 = certain. Nothing can be more likely than certain.
questp1-basics#42.af: 0 = onmoontlik, 1 = seker. Niks kan meer waarskynlik as seker wees nie.

questp1-basics#43.en: ${bad} is outside the 0–1 range, so it is impossible as a probability.
questp1-basics#43.af: ${bad} lê buite 0 tot 1, dus kan dit nie 'n waarskynlikheid wees nie.

questp7-replacement#5.en: A bag holds ${N} balls. One is drawn and not replaced. How many balls are there for the second draw?
questp7-replacement#5.af: 'n Sak bevat ${N} balle. Een word getrek en nie teruggeplaas nie. Hoeveel balle is daar vir die tweede trekking?

questp7-replacement#6.en: Without replacement, the ball is kept out — the total drops by one.
questp7-replacement#6.af: Sonder terugplasing bly die bal uit: die totaal daal met een.

questp7-replacement#7.en: Without replacement the total falls from ${N} to ${N - 1}.
questp7-replacement#7.af: Sonder terugplasing daal die totaal van ${N} na ${N - 1}.

questp7-replacement#8.en: A bag has ${env.b.counts[c.k]} ${c.name} balls. One ${c.name} ball is drawn and not replaced. How many ${c.name} balls remain for the next draw?
questp7-replacement#8.af: 'n Sak het ${env.b.counts[c.k]} ${c.name} balle. Een ${c.name} bal word getrek en nie teruggeplaas nie. Hoeveel ${c.name} balle bly oor vir die volgende trekking?

questp7-replacement#9.en: The colour you took also drops by one.
questp7-replacement#9.af: Die kleur wat jy getrek het, daal ook met een.

questp7-replacement#10.en: Two balls are drawn from ${N}, ${replace ? "with" : "without"} replacement. Does the denominator change between the first and second draw?
questp7-replacement#10.af: Twee balle word uit ${N} getrek, ${replace ? "met" : "sonder"} terugplasing. Verander die noemer tussen die eerste en tweede trekking?

questp7-replacement#11.en: With replacement, the ball goes back — nothing changes.
questp7-replacement#11.af: Met terugplasing gaan die bal terug: niks verander nie.

questp7-replacement#12.en: Without replacement, one ball is gone — the total changes.
questp7-replacement#12.af: Sonder terugplasing is een bal weg: die totaal verander.

questp7-replacement#13.en: With replacement the total stays ${N}, so the denominator does NOT change.
questp7-replacement#13.af: Met terugplasing bly die totaal ${N}, dus verander die noemer NIE.

questp7-replacement#14.en: Without replacement it drops from ${N} to ${N - 1}, so the denominator DOES change.
questp7-replacement#14.af: Sonder terugplasing daal dit van ${N} na ${N - 1}, dus verander die noemer WEL.

questp7-replacement#15.en: A bag holds ${env.b.counts[env.cols[0].k]} ${env.cols[0].name} and ${env.b.counts[env.cols[1].k]} ${env.cols[1].name} balls. Two are drawn with replacement. Using the tree, find P(${p.k1}, ${p.k2}) in simplest form.
questp7-replacement#15.af: 'n Sak bevat ${env.b.counts[env.cols[0].k]} ${env.cols[0].name} en ${env.b.counts[env.cols[1].k]} ${env.cols[1].name} balle. Twee word met terugplasing getrek. Gebruik die boom en vind P(${p.k1}, ${p.k2}) in eenvoudigste vorm.

questp7-replacement#16.en: With replacement, both draws use the same total. Multiply along the path.
questp7-replacement#16.af: Met terugplasing gebruik albei trekkings dieselfde totaal. Vermenigvuldig langs die pad.

questp7-replacement#17.en: A bag holds ${env.b.counts[env.cols[0].k]} ${env.cols[0].name} and ${env.b.counts[env.cols[1].k]} ${env.cols[1].name} balls. Two are drawn without replacement. Using the tree, find P(${p.k1}, ${p.k2}) in simplest form.
questp7-replacement#17.af: 'n Sak bevat ${env.b.counts[env.cols[0].k]} ${env.cols[0].name} en ${env.b.counts[env.cols[1].k]} ${env.cols[1].name} balle. Twee word sonder terugplasing getrek. Gebruik die boom en vind P(${p.k1}, ${p.k2}) in eenvoudigste vorm.

questp7-replacement#18.en: Without replacement, the second denominator is one smaller — and the first colour drops by one.
questp7-replacement#18.af: Sonder terugplasing is die tweede noemer een kleiner, en die eerste kleur daal met een.

questp7-replacement#19.en: A bag holds ${env.b.counts[env.cols[0].k]} ${env.cols[0].name} and ${env.b.counts[env.cols[1].k]} ${env.cols[1].name} balls. Two are drawn ${replace ? "with" : "without"} replacement. Find P(at least one ${c.name}) in simplest form.
questp7-replacement#19.af: 'n Sak bevat ${env.b.counts[env.cols[0].k]} ${env.cols[0].name} en ${env.b.counts[env.cols[1].k]} ${env.cols[1].name} balle. Twee word ${replace ? "met" : "sonder"} terugplasing getrek. Vind P(ten minste een ${c.name}) in eenvoudigste vorm.

questp7-replacement#24.en: Two balls drawn without replacement. Tap the path for ${env.name(p.k1)} then ${env.name(p.k2)} (${p.path}).
questp7-replacement#24.af: Twee balle word sonder terugplasing getrek. Klik op die pad vir ${env.name(p.k1)} dan ${env.name(p.k2)} (${p.path}).

questp7-replacement#25.en: Match the outcome label on the right.
questp7-replacement#25.af: Soek die passende uitkomsetiket aan die regterkant.

questm3-open#2.en: Look at the diagram. Which formula gives this cylinder's total surface area?
questm3-open#2.af: Kyk na die diagram. Watter formule gee hierdie silinder se totale buite-oppervlakte?

questm3-open#3.en: Start with the curved side 2πrh (always there). Then add one circle πr² for each end that is closed — a solid lid, not an open rim.
questm3-open#3.af: Begin met die geboë sy 2πrh (altyd daar). Tel dan een sirkel πr² by vir elke geslote ent: 'n vaste deksel, nie 'n oop rand nie.

questm3-open#10.af: geen geslote ente → tel niks by

questm3-open#13.en: Look at the top of this cylinder. Do you include the top circle in its surface area?
questm3-open#13.af: Kyk na die bokant van hierdie silinder. Tel jy die boonste sirkel by sy buite-oppervlakte?

questm3-open#14.en: A solid lid is a real surface to count; an open rim you can see into has no lid there to cover.
questm3-open#14.af: 'n Vaste deksel is 'n regte vlak wat tel; 'n oop rand waar jy kan inkyk, het geen deksel nie.

questm3-open#15.en: Yes — the top is a closed lid, so its circle counts: + πr².
questm3-open#15.af: Ja, die bokant is 'n geslote deksel, so sy sirkel tel: + πr².

questm3-open#16.en: No — the top is open, so there is no top circle to include.
questm3-open#16.af: Nee, die bokant is oop, so daar is geen boonste sirkel om by te tel nie.

questm3-open#17.en: Closed top (solid lid) → count its circle: + πr².
questm3-open#17.af: Geslote bokant (vaste deksel) → tel sy sirkel: + πr².

questm3-open#18.en: Open top → leave out πr² for the top; only count ends that are closed.
questm3-open#18.af: Oop bokant → los πr² vir die bokant uit; tel net die geslote ente.

questm3-open#19.en: This pipe is open at both ends. Which surface(s) make up its outer area?
questm3-open#19.af: Hierdie pyp is aan albei ente oop. Watter vlak(ke) vorm sy buite-oppervlakte?

questm3-open#22.en: the curved side + one circle → πr² + 2πrh
questm3-open#22.af: die geboë sy + een sirkel → πr² + 2πrh

questm3-open#24.en: No lids at all — you can see straight through. So no circles are counted.
questm3-open#24.af: Glad geen deksels nie: jy kan reg deur kyk. Dus tel geen sirkels nie.

questm3-open#25.en: Just the curved side, 2πrh — a pipe has no closed ends.
questm3-open#25.af: Net die geboë sy, 2πrh: 'n pyp het geen geslote ente nie.

questm3-open#27.en: A rectangular fish tank is open at the top (no lid). How many faces make up the glass surface?
questm3-open#27.af: 'n Reghoekige vistenk is bo oop (geen deksel nie). Hoeveel vlakke vorm die glasoppervlak?

questm3-open#32.en: A closed box has 6 faces. Remove the lid and one face is gone.
questm3-open#32.af: 'n Geslote boks het 6 vlakke. Haal die deksel af en een vlak is weg.

questm3-open#33.en: 5 — the base and the 4 sides; the top (lid) is left out.
questm3-open#33.af: 5: die basis en die 4 sye; die bokant (deksel) word uitgelaat.

questm4-composite#3.en: For the total surface area, do you include the dashed circle where the ${topName} sits on the cylinder?
questm4-composite#3.af: Tel jy vir die totale buite-oppervlakte die gestippelde sirkel by waar die ${topName} op die silinder sit?

questm4-composite#4.en: That circle is sealed inside the solid — no one could paint it. Joined faces are left out.
questm4-composite#4.af: Daardie sirkel is binne-in die liggaam toegemaak: niemand kan dit verf nie. Raakvlakke word uitgelaat.

questm4-composite#5.en: No — the joining face is hidden inside, so it is not part of the outer surface.
questm4-composite#5.af: Nee, die raakvlak is binne versteek, so dit is nie deel van die buite-oppervlakte nie.

questm4-composite#6.en: Two solids joined → add the outer surfaces, omit the shared (hidden) face.
questm4-composite#6.af: Twee liggame aanmekaar → tel die buitenste vlakke op, los die gedeelde (versteekte) vlak uit.

questm4-composite#7.en: What is the total volume of this silo (a cylinder with a cone on top)?
questm4-composite#7.af: Wat is die totale volume van hierdie silo ('n silinder met 'n keël bo-op)?

questm4-composite#12.en: Add the two parts: cylinder (πr²h) plus cone (⅓πr²H). h is the cylinder height, H the cone height.
questm4-composite#12.af: Tel die twee dele op: silinder (πr²h) plus keël (⅓πr²H). h is die silinder se hoogte, H die keël se hoogte.

questm4-composite#13.en: Add the parts: cylinder πr²h + cone ⅓πr²H.
questm4-composite#13.af: Tel die dele op: silinder πr²h + keël ⅓πr²H.

questm4-composite#17.en: What is the total volume of this tank (a cylinder with a hemisphere on top)?
questm4-composite#17.af: Wat is die totale volume van hierdie tenk ('n silinder met 'n halfsfeer bo-op)?

questm4-composite#22.en: A hemisphere is HALF a sphere, so ½ × 4/3·πr³ = ⅔πr³. Add it to the cylinder πr²h.
questm4-composite#22.af: 'n Halfsfeer is 'n HALWE sfeer, so ½ × 4/3·πr³ = ⅔πr³. Tel dit by die silinder πr²h.

questm4-composite#26.en: Which surfaces add up to the total surface area of this silo (closed flat bottom, cone on top)?
questm4-composite#26.af: Watter vlakke tel op tot die totale buite-oppervlakte van hierdie silo (geslote plat bodem, keël bo-op)?

questm4-composite#27.en: bottom circle + cylinder's curved side + cone's slanted surface
questm4-composite#27.af: onderste sirkel + silinder se geboë sy + keël se skuins vlak

questm4-composite#28.en: bottom circle + cylinder's curved side + cone's slanted surface + the join circle
questm4-composite#28.af: onderste sirkel + silinder se geboë sy + keël se skuins vlak + die raakvlak

questm4-composite#29.en: two circles + cylinder's curved side + cone's slanted surface
questm4-composite#29.af: twee sirkels + silinder se geboë sy + keël se skuins vlak

questm4-composite#30.en: cylinder's curved side + cone's slanted surface only
questm4-composite#30.af: net silinder se geboë sy + keël se skuins vlak

questm4-composite#31.en: Count every OUTSIDE face: the base, the wrapping cylinder wall, the cone's slope. The circle where they join is hidden.
questm4-composite#31.af: Tel elke BUITENSTE vlak: die basis, die silinderwand rondom, die keël se helling. Die sirkel waar hulle aanmekaar sit, is versteek.

questm4-composite#32.en: Base circle + cylinder side + cone slant. The cylinder's top is covered by the cone, so it is left out.
questm4-composite#32.af: Basissirkel + silindersy + keël se skuins vlak. Die keël bedek die silinder se bokant, so dit word uitgelaat.

questm4-composite#33.en: outer faces only: πr² (base) + 2πrh (cylinder side) + πr·(slant) (cone)

questm4-composite#34.en: To find the volume of a composite solid, do you add the volumes of its parts?
questm4-composite#34.af: Kry jy die volume van 'n saamgestelde liggaam deur die volumes van sy dele op te tel?

questm4-composite#35.en: Volume is just how much space is filled, so the parts simply add up — nothing is hidden for volume.
questm4-composite#35.af: Volume is net hoeveel ruimte gevul is, so die dele tel eenvoudig op: niks is versteek vir volume nie.

questm4-composite#36.en: Yes — total volume = sum of the parts' volumes.
questm4-composite#36.af: Ja: totale volume = som van die dele se volumes.

questm5-mixed#3.en: Flat faces only → prism or pyramid. A curved face → cylinder, cone, sphere or hemisphere.
questm5-mixed#3.af: Net plat vlakke → prisma of piramide. 'n Geboë vlak → silinder, keël, sfeer of halfsfeer.

questm5-mixed#5.af: Kies die formule vir die volume van hierdie ${s.name}.

questm5-mixed#6.en: Prisms/cylinder: base × height. Cone/pyramid: ⅓ of that. Sphere 4/3·πr³, hemisphere half of it.
questm5-mixed#6.af: Prismas/silinder: basis × hoogte. Keël/piramide: ⅓ daarvan. Sfeer 4/3·πr³, halfsfeer die helfte daarvan.

questm5-mixed#9.en: Pick the total surface area formula for this closed ${s.name}.
questm5-mixed#9.af: Kies die formule vir die totale buite-oppervlakte van hierdie geslote ${s.name}.

questm5-mixed#10.en: Add every outside face. Curved sides unroll into rectangles; round ends are circles.
questm5-mixed#10.af: Tel elke buitenste vlak op. Geboë sye rol oop in reghoeke; ronde ente is sirkels.

questm5-mixed#15.en: Read the diagram — which surface-area formula fits this cylinder?
questm5-mixed#15.af: Lees die diagram: watter formule vir buite-oppervlakte pas by hierdie silinder?

questm5-mixed#16.en: Curved side 2πrh always; add πr² for each CLOSED end.
questm5-mixed#16.af: Geboë sy 2πrh altyd; tel πr² by vir elke GESLOTE ent.

questm5-mixed#18.en: Every dimension of a solid is multiplied by ${k}. Its volume becomes how many times as big?
questm5-mixed#18.af: Elke afmeting van 'n liggaam word met ${k} vermenigvuldig. Hoeveel keer so groot word sy volume?

questm5-mixed#19.en: Volume uses three lengths, so it scales by k × k × k = k³.
questm5-mixed#19.af: Volume gebruik drie lengtes, so dit skaleer met k × k × k = k³.

questm5-mixed#22.en: Every dimension of a solid is multiplied by ${k}. Its surface area becomes how many times as big?
questm5-mixed#22.af: Elke afmeting van 'n liggaam word met ${k} vermenigvuldig. Hoeveel keer so groot word sy buite-oppervlakte?

questm5-mixed#23.en: Area uses two lengths, so it scales by k × k = k².
questm5-mixed#23.af: Oppervlakte gebruik twee lengtes, so dit skaleer met k × k = k².
